description: Public Ed25519 keys that sign DevMatrix evidence. A signature is accepted only when its key_id and its inline public_key are one entry here and its signed_at falls inside that entry's window. Only class "production" keys sign DevMatrix attestations; development and local keys are listed so their evidence can be identified, never accepted as an attestation by default.

keys.window: first and last signature of this key in this repository; the key was replaced
keys.anchor: documented: published with the design of the DevMatrix evidence system

keys.window: from the first signature of this key in this repository; current key
keys.anchor: pending: not yet published by an independent channel
